pinyin: zhī nán xíng yì
literal: knowing · hard · doing · easy
natural: knowing is hard, doing is easy

meaning.en: Sun Yat-sen's thesis that understanding is the hard part and action the easy part, so people should dare to act once they understand.
meaning.zh: 孙中山提出的学说：认识事物难，实行起来反而容易，主张人们有了认识就要大胆去做。

examples.zh: 孙中山主张知难行易，认为认识比实践更难。
examples.en: Sun Yat-sen held that knowing is hard and doing is easy, so understanding is the greater challenge.

examples.zh: 政治课上，老师比较了知难行易和知行合一两种观点。
examples.en: In politics class the teacher compared the views 'knowing is hard, doing is easy' and 'unity of knowing and doing'.

story.en: Sun Yat-sen set out the idea in 'Sun Wen's Doctrine' (《孙文学说》, 1919), arguing against the traditional view that knowing is easy and acting hard.
story.zh: 孙中山在《孙文学说》（1919年）中提出此说，反对“知易行难”的传统观念。

usage.en: A philosophical term, mostly met in history and politics lessons. It reverses the older saying 知易行难 ('knowing is easy, doing is hard'), which is the everyday view. Formal.
usage.zh: 哲学术语，多见于历史、政治课。与传统说法“知易行难”正好相反，后者才是日常的看法。正式。

pinyin: dǎ dǎo liè qiáng chú jūn fá
literal: overthrow · great powers · remove · warlords
natural: down with the foreign powers, away with the warlords

meaning.en: A slogan of the 1920s National Revolution: end foreign domination and the rule of regional warlords to unify China.
meaning.zh: 1920年代国民革命的口号：打倒外国列强、铲除军阀割据，实现国家统一。

equivalents: end foreign domination and warlord rule

examples.zh: 北伐时期，学生们高唱“打倒列强除军阀”。
examples.en: During the Northern Expedition students sang 'down with the powers, away with the warlords'.

examples.zh: 展览回顾了“打倒列强除军阀”的歌声响彻街头的年代。
examples.en: The exhibition recalls the years when the cry 'down with the powers, away with the warlords' rang through the streets.

usage.en: Best known as the opening of the 1926 'National Revolution Song' (《国民革命歌》), sung to the tune of 'Frère Jacques', and used since as shorthand for the Northern Expedition era. Today a historical reference. No origin is given because the authorship of the lyrics is disputed.
usage.zh: 最初是1926年《国民革命歌》的开头，曲调取自法国儿歌，后来成为北伐时代的代名词。今天多作历史引用。歌词作者说法不一，故不标出处。

pinyin: láo gōng shén shèng
literal: labourers · work · sacred · holy
natural: labour is sacred

meaning.en: The dignity of labour: those who do manual work deserve the highest respect.
meaning.zh: 劳动者和他们的劳动是神圣的，应当受到尊重。

examples.zh: 校园里的标语写着“劳工神圣”，提醒同学尊重清洁工人。
examples.en: The slogan 'labour is sacred' on campus reminds students to respect the cleaners.

examples.zh: 他从小就懂得劳工神圣的道理，从不看不起体力劳动。
examples.en: He learned early that labour is sacred and never looked down on manual work.

origin.source: 蔡元培《劳工神圣》演讲（1918年）

story.en: Cai Yuanpei, president of Peking University, gave a speech titled 'Labour is Sacred' in November 1918 at a Tiananmen rally celebrating the end of the First World War.
story.zh: 1918年11月，北京大学校长蔡元培在天安门庆祝第一次世界大战结束的集会上发表演讲《劳工神圣》。

usage.en: A formal, positive slogan, often used in May Day and school-education contexts. Older texts have 劳工神圣; modern usage often has 劳动神圣.
usage.zh: 正式、褒义的口号，常见于五一节和学校教育。旧文献多作“劳工神圣”，今天也常说“劳动神圣”。

text: 读书不忘救国，救国不忘读书
pinyin: dú shū bù wàng jiù guó, jiù guó bù wàng dú shū
literal: study · not · forget · save · country, save · country · not · forget · study
natural: study without forgetting the nation, serve the nation without giving up study

meaning.en: A student slogan: do not neglect the nation's plight while studying, and do not abandon your studies in the cause of national salvation.
meaning.zh: 学生口号：读书时不忘国家危难，救国时也不放弃学业，两者并重。

equivalents: study and serve your country together
keep learning and keep the nation in mind

examples.zh: 爱国学生提出“读书不忘救国，救国不忘读书”。
examples.en: Patriotic students put forward the motto 'study without forgetting the nation, serve the nation without abandoning study'.

examples.zh: 校史馆里挂着“读书不忘救国，救国不忘读书”的标语。
examples.en: The school museum displays the slogan 'study without forgetting the nation, serve the nation without abandoning study'.

usage.en: A balanced, chiastic slogan from the student movements of the Republican era; used in history lessons and school essays. There is no reliable single source, so no origin is given.
usage.zh: 民国学生运动中流传的对称式口号，多用于历史课和学校作文。没有可靠的单一出处，故不标出处。

text: 中华民族到了最危险的时候
pinyin: zhōng huá mín zú dào le zuì wēi xiǎn de shí hou
literal: Chinese · nation · arrived · most · dangerous · 's · time
natural: the Chinese nation has reached its most dangerous hour

meaning.en: A line from China's national anthem: the nation is at its moment of greatest peril and everyone must rise to defend it.
meaning.zh: 中国国歌歌词：民族处于最危险的关头，每个人都要奋起保卫国家。

examples.zh: 国歌里唱道：“中华民族到了最危险的时候”。
examples.en: The national anthem sings, 'the Chinese nation has reached its most dangerous hour'.

examples.zh: 电影回顾了“中华民族到了最危险的时候”那一段岁月。
examples.en: The film looks back at the years when 'the Chinese nation had reached its most dangerous hour'.

origin.source: 《义勇军进行曲》，田汉词、聂耳曲（1935年）

story.en: The song was written for the 1935 film 'Children of Troubled Times' (《风云儿女》), with words by Tian Han and music by Nie Er; it became China's national anthem.
story.zh: 该曲为1935年电影《风云儿女》而作，田汉作词，聂耳作曲，后成为中国国歌。

usage.en: Quoted when recalling the Anti-Japanese War, or sometimes of any national crisis. The full lyric continues 每个人被迫着发出最后的吼声. Formal.
usage.zh: 回顾抗日战争或形容国家危机时引用。下句是“每个人被迫着发出最后的吼声”。正式。

pinyin: kàng zhàn dào dǐ
literal: resist · war · to · the end
natural: fight the war of resistance to the end

meaning.en: A wartime slogan of the Second Sino-Japanese War: keep resisting Japan until final victory, with no compromise.
meaning.zh: 抗日战争时期的口号：坚持抵抗日本侵略，直到最后胜利，决不妥协。

examples.zh: 全国各界发表通电，表示要抗战到底。
examples.en: People from all walks of life issued telegrams pledging to fight the war of resistance to the end.

examples.zh: 纪念馆里陈列着“抗战到底”的旧海报。
examples.en: The memorial hall displays old posters reading 'resist to the end'.

usage.en: Mainly a historical reference to 1937-1945, used across all political camps of the time. Today also used loosely of sticking to a fight. Formal.
usage.zh: 主要指1937至1945年的抗战时期，当时各党派都使用。今天也泛指坚持斗争到底。正式。

pinyin: zuì hòu guān tóu
literal: final · last · pass · juncture
natural: the last moment, the final critical point

meaning.en: The critical point at which there is no further room for retreat; made famous by Chiang Kai-shek's 1937 Lushan statement on the limit of endurance.
meaning.zh: 没有退路的关键时刻；因1937年蒋介石庐山谈话而广为人知。

examples.zh: 谈判到了最后关头，双方仍未让步。
examples.en: The talks reached the last critical moment and neither side had yielded.

examples.zh: 医生说，要到最后关头才会考虑手术。
examples.en: The doctor said surgery would be considered only at the last moment.

origin.source: 蒋介石庐山谈话（1937年7月17日）

story.en: In his Lushan statement after the Marco Polo Bridge Incident, Chiang Kai-shek said that China would not abandon peace until the point of utter hopelessness and would not lightly speak of sacrifice until the final juncture (最后关头).
story.zh: 卢沟桥事变后，蒋介石在庐山谈话中说：“和平未到根本绝望时期，决不放弃和平；牺牲未到最后关头，决不轻言牺牲。”

usage.en: A common set phrase in news and speech. Historically tied to Chiang Kai-shek's 17 July 1937 Lushan speech, which said China would not give up peace until hope was gone and would not speak of sacrifice until the final juncture (最后关头). Neutral, formal.
usage.zh: 新闻和演讲中的常用语。与1937年7月17日蒋介石庐山谈话有关，谈话称“牺牲未到最后关头，决不轻言牺牲”。中性，正式。

text: 宜将剩勇追穷寇，不可沽名学霸王
pinyin: yí jiāng shèng yǒng zhuī qióng kòu, bù kě gū míng xué bà wáng
literal: should · use · remaining · courage · chase · cornered · foe, must not · seek · fame · imitate · Overlord
natural: use your remaining strength to chase the cornered enemy; do not play Overlord for a name

meaning.en: Press on and finish off a beaten enemy instead of seeking a reputation for magnanimity as Xiang Yu did.
meaning.zh: 乘胜追击，彻底击败残敌，不要像项羽那样为博取虚名而放过对手。

examples.zh: 球队领先后教练提醒大家：宜将剩勇追穷寇，不可沽名学霸王。
examples.en: With the lead secured, the coach reminded the team: press the advantage and finish the job, don't be magnanimous for show.

examples.zh: 改革已到关键阶段，宜将剩勇追穷寇，不可沽名学霸王。
examples.en: The reform is at a critical stage: press on and finish the job rather than stop for appearances.

origin.source: 毛泽东《七律·人民解放军占领南京》（1949年）

story.en: Mao Zedong wrote the poem in April 1949 on the People's Liberation Army's capture of Nanjing; in it he urges the army to pursue the defeated enemy and not, like Xiang Yu, seek a name for mercy.
story.zh: 1949年4月人民解放军占领南京，毛泽东作此诗，号召乘胜追击，不学项羽沽名钓誉。

usage.en: Quoted as encouragement to see a task through once momentum is won. The 'Overlord' is Xiang Yu (项羽), who let Liu Bang escape. Literary, positive.
usage.zh: 用来鼓励乘胜彻底完成任务。“霸王”指项羽，他曾放走刘邦。书面语，褒义。

pinyin: yī wàn nián tài jiǔ, zhǐ zhēng zhāo xī
literal: one · ten thousand · years · too · long, only · contend · morning · evening
natural: ten thousand years is too long; seize the day

meaning.en: Waiting for a far-off future is too slow; seize every day and hour and act now.
meaning.zh: 遥远的将来太漫长，要抓紧每一天、每一刻，现在就行动。

examples.zh: 科研团队以“一万年太久，只争朝夕”自勉，加班攻关。
examples.en: The research team encouraged itself with 'ten thousand years is too long; seize the day' and worked overtime.

examples.zh: 时间不等人，一万年太久，只争朝夕。
examples.en: Time waits for no one; ten thousand years is too long, so seize the day.

origin.source: 毛泽东《满江红·和郭沫若同志》（1963年）

story.en: Mao Zedong wrote this poem in January 1963 in reply to Guo Moruo; the passage reads '多少事，从来急；天地转，光阴迫。一万年太久，只争朝夕。'
story.zh: 1963年1月毛泽东和郭沫若《满江红》，词中有“多少事，从来急；天地转，光阴迫。一万年太久，只争朝夕。”

usage.en: The second half is the well-known set phrase 只争朝夕, which has its own entry. The full line is quoted in speeches and slogans about urgency. Positive, literary.
usage.zh: 后半“只争朝夕”已是常用成语，另有词条。全句常见于强调紧迫感的讲话和标语。褒义，书面语。

text: 待到山花烂漫时，她在丛中笑
pinyin: dài dào shān huā làn màn shí, tā zài cóng zhōng xiào
literal: wait · until · mountain · flowers · bright · profuse · time, she · in · thicket · smile
natural: when the mountain flowers are in full bloom, she will be smiling among them

meaning.en: The plum blossom, which blooms first and modestly, smiles when spring comes and others flower; it stands for selfless pioneers who are glad to see others succeed.
meaning.zh: 梅花率先开放而不争春，待到春花盛开，她在丛中欣然微笑，比喻不求功名、乐见大家成功的先行者。

equivalents: to be content to pave the way

examples.zh: 老教授默默培养学生，真是待到山花烂漫时，她在丛中笑。
examples.en: The old professor quietly trained her students: when the mountain flowers bloom, she will be smiling among them.

examples.zh: 她为同事铺路，从不争功，待到山花烂漫时，她在丛中笑。
examples.en: She cleared the way for her colleagues without claiming credit: when the flowers bloom she will smile among them.

story.en: Mao Zedong wrote this poem in December 1961 in reply to Lu You's poem of the same title; it presents the plum as modest and unafraid of the cold.
story.zh: 1961年12月毛泽东读陆游《卜算子·咏梅》后反其意而作此词，赞梅花不畏严寒、谦逊无争。

usage.en: Quoted in praise of modest, selfless people who do the groundwork. The 'she' (她) refers to the plum blossom. Positive, literary.
usage.zh: 用来赞扬默默奠基、不争名利的人。“她”指梅花。褒义，书面语。

text: 已是悬崖百丈冰，犹有花枝俏
pinyin: yǐ shì xuán yá bǎi zhàng bīng, yóu yǒu huā zhī qiào
literal: already · is · cliff · hundred · zhang · ice, still · has · flower · branch · pretty
natural: the cliff is hung with ice a hundred zhang deep, yet a flowering branch stays lovely

meaning.en: Even in the harshest cold, a flowering branch still blooms beautifully; a picture of beauty and courage in adversity.
meaning.zh: 在极寒的环境中仍有花枝美丽绽放，比喻在艰难困苦中依然保持风骨和生机。

examples.zh: 她在重病中依然乐观工作，真是已是悬崖百丈冰，犹有花枝俏。
examples.en: Even in grave illness she kept working cheerfully: the cliff is iced over, yet a flowering branch still stands out.

examples.zh: 寒冬里的梅花让人想起“已是悬崖百丈冰，犹有花枝俏”。
examples.en: The plum blossom in the dead of winter recalls the line 'the cliff is iced a hundred zhang deep, yet a flowering branch is lovely'.

story.en: The opening lines of the poem read '风雨送春归，飞雪迎春到。已是悬崖百丈冰，犹有花枝俏。'
story.zh: 此词上阕为“风雨送春归，飞雪迎春到。已是悬崖百丈冰，犹有花枝俏。”

usage.en: Quoted to praise resilience under hardship. A 丈 (zhang) is about three metres, so 百丈 means 'immensely deep'. Positive, literary.
usage.zh: 用来赞美逆境中不屈不挠的精神。一丈约三米，“百丈”形容极厚。褒义，书面语。

pinyin: pí fú hàn shù tán hé yì
literal: big ant · shake · tree · talk · how · easy
natural: for an ant to shake a tree, how easy could it be

meaning.en: Trying to topple something far bigger and stronger is not easy; said of hopeless attempts by the weak against the strong.
meaning.zh: 蚂蚁想撼动大树，谈何容易；比喻弱小者想动摇强大的对象，是不可能的。

equivalents: an ant can't shake a tree

examples.zh: 小公司想撼动行业巨头，蚍蜉撼树谈何易。
examples.en: A small firm trying to unseat the industry giant: for an ant to shake a tree is no easy matter.

examples.zh: 论辩时他自觉势单力薄，叹道蚍蜉撼树谈何易。
examples.en: Feeling outmatched in the debate, he sighed that an ant shaking a tree is no easy thing.

origin.source: 毛泽东《满江红·和郭沫若同志》（1963年）

story.en: The line appears in Mao's 1963 poem replying to Guo Moruo, which also contains '一万年太久，只争朝夕'; the image of 蚍蜉撼树 itself goes back to Han Yu's Tang-dynasty poem.
story.zh: 此句出自毛泽东1963年和郭沫若《满江红》，同词还有“一万年太久，只争朝夕”；“蚍蜉撼树”的比喻本身可追溯到唐代韩愈诗。

usage.en: The shorter 蚍蜉撼树 is a separate entry; this is the full line, which adds 'how could it be easy'. Mao's poem uses it to mock hostile forces; today it is quoted ironically about attempts against the odds. Literary.
usage.zh: 较短的“蚍蜉撼树”另有词条，此为全句，多出“谈何易”。毛泽东原诗用来讥讽敌对势力，今天多反讽以弱敌强的尝试。书面语。

pinyin: yī chàng xióng jī tiān xià bái
literal: one · crow · rooster · under heaven · white
natural: one crow of the cock and the whole world turns light

meaning.en: A single rooster's crow brings dawn to the whole world; a metaphor for a great new era beginning.
meaning.zh: 一声鸡鸣，天下大亮；比喻黑暗过去，新时代到来。

equivalents: the break of a new era

examples.zh: 新法实施的那天，人们说这真是一唱雄鸡天下白。
examples.en: On the day the new law took effect people said it was truly a new dawn.

examples.zh: 改革开放初期，一唱雄鸡天下白，整个社会焕然一新。
examples.en: In the early reform years a new dawn broke and society looked fresh again.

origin.source: 毛泽东《七律·和郭沫若同志》（1961年）

story.en: The line comes from Mao's 1961 poem replying to Guo Moruo, which reads '一唱雄鸡天下白，万方乐奏有于阗'.
story.zh: 此句出自毛泽东1961年《七律·和郭沫若同志》：“一唱雄鸡天下白，万方乐奏有于阗。”

usage.en: Mao's line echoes the Tang poet Li He's '雄鸡一声天下白' (《致酒行》). Quoted for a turning point or fresh start. Positive, literary.
usage.zh: 毛泽东此句化用唐代李贺《致酒行》中的“雄鸡一声天下白”。用于形容转折点或新开端。褒义，书面语。

pinyin: liù yì shén zhōu jìn shùn yáo
literal: six hundred million · Divine Land · all · Shun · Yao
natural: the six hundred million of the Divine Land are all sages like Shun and Yao

meaning.en: Everyone in the land is as virtuous as the sage-kings Yao and Shun; an ideal of a society of good people.
meaning.zh: 全国人民都像尧舜那样贤德，描绘人人向善的理想社会。

equivalents: everyone as good as the ancient sages

examples.zh: 看到志愿者踊跃捐款，他感叹六亿神州尽舜尧。
examples.en: Seeing volunteers donate so eagerly, he marvelled that all the Divine Land were Yaos and Shuns.

examples.zh: 诗中“六亿神州尽舜尧”表达了对新社会的期望。
examples.en: The line 'the six hundred million of the Divine Land are all Shun and Yao' expresses hope for the new society.

origin.source: 毛泽东《七律二首·送瘟神》（1958年）

story.en: The line is from the first of Mao's two 1958 poems 'Sending Off the Plague God', written on the elimination of schistosomiasis in Yujiang County; it follows '春风杨柳万千条'.
story.zh: 出自毛泽东1958年《七律二首·送瘟神》其一，为庆祝余江县消灭血吸虫病而作，上句为“春风杨柳万千条”。

usage.en: Written when China had about 600 million people; today often quoted with another number or adapted humorously. 神州 is a poetic name for China, and 尧 and 舜 are legendary sage-kings. Literary.
usage.zh: 写作时中国约有六亿人口，今天引用时常改换数字或戏用。“神州”是中国的雅称，尧、舜是传说中的圣王。书面语。

pinyin: zhōng guó rén mín zhàn qǐ lái le
literal: China · people · stand · up · come · (completed)
natural: the Chinese people have stood up

meaning.en: A slogan for national independence: China, after a century of humiliation, would no longer be pushed around.
meaning.zh: 民族独立的口号：经历百年屈辱后，中国人民不再受人欺凌。

equivalents: the Chinese people have stood up
China will no longer be bullied

examples.zh: 纪念馆里循环播放着“中国人民站起来了”的演讲。
examples.en: The memorial hall replays the speech declaring that the Chinese people have stood up.

examples.zh: 国庆展览的主题是“中国人民站起来了”。
examples.en: The theme of the National Day exhibition is 'the Chinese people have stood up'.

usage.en: A set phrase tied to the founding of the People's Republic in 1949, when Mao Zedong spoke of the Chinese people having 'stood up' (the best-known formulation in English is 'the Chinese people have stood up'). It is often followed by 富起来 and 强起来 in later official speeches. Formal. The exact wording of the shorthand varies, so no origin is given.
usage.zh: 与1949年新中国成立相关的常用说法，毛泽东当时讲到中国人民“站起来了”。后来官方讲话中常与“富起来”“强起来”连用。正式。简称的措辞不一，故不标出处。

text: 帝国主义亡我之心不死
pinyin: dì guó zhǔ yì wáng wǒ zhī xīn bù sǐ
literal: imperialism · destroy · our · 's · heart · not · die
natural: imperialism's desire to destroy us has not died

meaning.en: A Mao-era slogan warning that foreign powers still sought to undermine China, so vigilance must not be relaxed.
meaning.zh: 毛泽东时代的口号，警告外国势力仍想颠覆中国，不可放松警惕。

equivalents: the enemy has not given up

examples.zh: 上世纪六十年代的标语常写着“帝国主义亡我之心不死”。
examples.en: Slogans of the 1960s often read 'imperialism has not given up its wish to destroy us'.

examples.zh: 他在回忆录里提到，“帝国主义亡我之心不死”曾是当时的口头禅。
examples.en: In his memoir he said 'imperialism's wish to destroy us has not died' was a catchphrase of the time.

usage.en: A historical slogan of the Mao era (1950s-70s), reflecting the Cold War outlook. Today it is mainly a historical reference, occasionally used ironically. Political register, formal. No single source is cited.
usage.zh: 毛泽东时代（1950—1970年代）的口号，反映冷战背景。今天主要作历史引用，偶有反讽。政治用语，正式。不标单一出处。

pinyin: shēn wā dòng, guǎng jī liáng, bù chēng bà
literal: deep · dig · tunnels, widely · store · grain, not · claim · hegemony
natural: dig tunnels deep, store grain widely, never seek hegemony

meaning.en: A 1970s defence-preparation slogan: build air-raid shelters, stockpile grain, and do not seek to dominate others.
meaning.zh: 1970年代的战备口号：修建防空洞、广泛储粮，同时不称霸。

examples.zh: 老城区至今保留着当年“深挖洞，广积粮，不称霸”时期挖的防空洞。
examples.en: The old district still has air-raid shelters dug in the days of 'dig deep, store grain, never seek hegemony'.

examples.zh: 墙上斑驳的“深挖洞，广积粮，不称霸”标语勾起了老人的回忆。
examples.en: The faded slogan 'dig deep, store grain, never seek hegemony' brought back memories for the old man.

usage.en: Attributed to Mao Zedong and publicised in the early 1970s, during tension with the Soviet Union. Today a historical reference, found on old walls and in museums. Formal.
usage.zh: 据称出自毛泽东，1970年代初中苏关系紧张时广泛宣传。今天多作历史引用，见于老墙标语和博物馆。正式。

pinyin: zhuā gé mìng, cù shēng chǎn
literal: grasp · revolution, promote · production
natural: grasp revolution, boost production

meaning.en: A Cultural Revolution slogan: carry on the political movement while keeping factories and farms producing.
meaning.zh: 文化大革命时期的口号：一手抓政治运动，一手保证工农业生产。

equivalents: keep politics and output going together

examples.zh: 七十年代的工厂墙上刷着“抓革命，促生产”。
examples.en: In the 1970s the factory walls were painted with 'grasp revolution, boost production'.

examples.zh: 博物馆展出了“抓革命，促生产”的旧海报。
examples.en: The museum exhibits old posters reading 'grasp revolution, boost production'.

usage.en: A slogan of the Cultural Revolution era (from about 1967), used to counter the disruption of production. Today a historical reference. Formal, political register.
usage.zh: 文化大革命时期（约1967年起）的口号，旨在对抗运动对生产的冲击。今天多作历史引用。正式，政治用语。

pinyin: bèi zhàn bèi huāng wèi rén mín
literal: prepare · war · prepare · famine · for · the people
natural: prepare for war and famine for the people's sake

meaning.en: A 1960s-70s slogan: be ready for war and for natural disaster, so the people can be protected.
meaning.zh: 1960至70年代的口号：为战争和灾荒做好准备，保障人民安全。

equivalents: be prepared for war and famine

examples.zh: 三线建设时期的标语写着“备战备荒为人民”。
examples.en: Slogans in the Third Front construction period read 'prepare for war and famine for the people'.

examples.zh: 老工人回忆起“备战备荒为人民”的年代。
examples.en: The veteran worker recalled the years of 'prepare for war and famine for the people'.

usage.en: Associated with Mao Zedong in the mid-1960s and with the Third Front construction in China's interior. Used today as a historical reference. Formal.
usage.zh: 与毛泽东1960年代中期的号召及内地三线建设相关。今天多作历史引用。正式。

pinyin: dòu sī pī xiū
literal: fight · selfishness · criticise · revisionism
natural: fight selfishness, criticise revisionism

meaning.en: A Cultural Revolution slogan: struggle against self-interested thoughts and criticise 'revisionism', i.e. views labelled as deviating from official Marxism.
meaning.zh: 文化大革命时期的口号：与私心杂念作斗争，批判所谓修正主义。

examples.zh: 档案里保存着当年“斗私批修”学习班的记录。
examples.en: The archive keeps records of the 'fight selfishness, criticise revisionism' study classes.

examples.zh: 展览里有一张写着“斗私批修”的老标语。
examples.en: The exhibition includes an old slogan reading 'fight selfishness, criticise revisionism'.

usage.en: A short form of '斗私，批修', a Cultural Revolution slogan (from about 1967). Today a historical reference. Formal, political register.
usage.zh: 是“斗私，批修”的简称，文化大革命时期（约1967年起）的口号。今天多作历史引用。正式，政治用语。

pinyin: líng hún shēn chù nào gé mìng
literal: soul · deep · place · make · revolution
natural: start a revolution deep in the soul

meaning.en: A Cultural Revolution slogan urging people to root out selfish or 'wrong' ideas through self-criticism.
meaning.zh: 文化大革命时期的口号，要求通过自我批判清除私心杂念和所谓错误思想。

equivalents: root out wrong thinking within oneself

examples.zh: 六十年代的学习班上，大家被要求灵魂深处闹革命。
examples.en: At study sessions in the 1960s people were told to start a revolution deep in their souls.

examples.zh: 他在回忆里写到“灵魂深处闹革命”的口号。
examples.en: In his recollections he wrote of the slogan 'start a revolution deep in the soul'.

usage.en: Popularised from the mid-1960s, from about 1966 especially in the Cultural Revolution. Today mostly a historical reference, sometimes used wryly of intense self-examination. Formal, political register.
usage.zh: 1960年代中期开始流行，尤其是1966年文化大革命时期。今天多作历史引用，有时戏指深刻的自我反省。正式，政治用语。

pinyin: xué xí léi fēng hǎo bǎng yàng
literal: learn · Lei Feng · good · role model
natural: learn from Lei Feng, a fine example

meaning.en: Learn from Lei Feng, the soldier held up as a model of selfless service; the title and refrain of a well-known 1963 song.
meaning.zh: 向雷锋学习，他是无私奉献的榜样；也是1963年一首著名歌曲的名称和叠句。

equivalents: Lei Feng is a model to follow

examples.zh: 三月五日，学校组织同学们唱《学习雷锋好榜样》。
examples.en: On 5 March the school had students sing 'Learn from Lei Feng, a Fine Example'.

examples.zh: 志愿者们说，学习雷锋好榜样，要从身边小事做起。
examples.en: The volunteers said that to learn from Lei Feng, a fine example, one should start with small things nearby.

usage.en: Often sung or shouted on Learn from Lei Feng Day (5 March) and in volunteer drives. It follows Mao Zedong's 1963 inscription 向雷锋同志学习 (a separate entry). Positive, formal; today sometimes used lightly or ironically.
usage.zh: 常在3月5日学雷锋纪念日和志愿服务活动中唱或喊。出自毛泽东1963年题词“向雷锋同志学习”（另有词条）之后。褒义，正式；今天有时也轻松或反讽地使用。

pinyin: luò hòu jiù yào ái dǎ
literal: fall behind · then · must · suffer · beating
natural: those who fall behind get beaten

meaning.en: A country or person that is backward will be bullied by stronger rivals, so one must keep developing and strengthening.
meaning.zh: 落后的国家或个人会被强者欺凌，因此必须发展自强。

equivalents: fall behind and you pay the price

examples.zh: 领导常说落后就要挨打，要求我们加快技术研发。
examples.en: Our leaders often say that falling behind means getting beaten and urge us to speed up research.

examples.zh: 回顾近代史，人们常说落后就要挨打。
examples.en: Looking back on modern history, people often say that those who lag behind get beaten.

origin.source: 斯大林《论经济工作人员的任务》（1931年）

story.en: In a February 1931 speech on the tasks of industrial managers, Stalin said that old Russia had been beaten again and again because of its backwardness, and that the Soviet Union had to close the gap within about ten years.
story.zh: 1931年2月斯大林在讲话中说，旧俄国因落后而屡遭挨打，苏联必须在十年左右追上先进国家。

usage.en: Often quoted in speeches on science, technology and national strength. It echoes Stalin's 1931 speech on the need to industrialise, which spoke of Russia being beaten for its backwardness. Formal, serious in tone.
usage.zh: 常见于科技和国力的讲话中。呼应斯大林1931年关于工业化的讲话，讲到俄国因落后而屡遭挨打。正式，语气严肃。

text: 时间就是金钱，效率就是生命
pinyin: shí jiān jiù shì jīn qián, xiào lǜ jiù shì shēng mìng
literal: time · exactly · is · money, efficiency · exactly · is · life
natural: time is money, efficiency is life

meaning.en: A reform-era business slogan: time and efficiency are as valuable as money and life, so waste neither.
meaning.zh: 改革开放时期的经济口号：时间和效率如同金钱和生命一样宝贵，不可浪费。

examples.zh: 工厂门口的标语写着：时间就是金钱，效率就是生命。
examples.en: The slogan at the factory gate read: time is money, efficiency is life.

examples.zh: 创业公司把“时间就是金钱，效率就是生命”挂在办公室墙上。
examples.en: The start-up hung 'time is money, efficiency is life' on its office wall.

origin.source: 袁庚，深圳蛇口工业区（1981年）

story.en: The slogan was put up in 1981 in the Shekou Industrial Zone, run by China Merchants under Yuan Geng, and became a symbol of Shenzhen's early reform drive.
story.zh: 1981年，在袁庚主持的招商局蛇口工业区立起这一标语，成为深圳早期改革的象征。

usage.en: Associated with the Shekou Industrial Zone in Shenzhen in the early 1980s, where it was displayed on a large sign and became a symbol of reform-era speed. Used in business and news. Positive, formal.
usage.zh: 与1980年代初深圳蛇口工业区有关，当时立有大幅标语，成为改革开放时代效率的象征。用于商业和新闻。褒义，正式。
